scene.title: A 20-step resolution workflow that restarts from step 1 every time a worker crashes
scene.sceneHtml:
TicketFlow: Week 8

You're building a long-running resolution workflow: classify → research KB → attempt fix → verify. Takes 20 steps. Workers sometimes crash mid-task. Without checkpointing, it restarts from step 1 every time. You implement state persistence: after each step, save progress to disk. On crash, resume from last checkpoint.

takeaways: The Agent SDK runs the reason, call tool, read result loop for you, with built-in tools, permissions, hooks, MCP and sessions.
Choose Agent SDK for multi-step work needing file, shell or web tools; choose Messages API for single-shot or custom tool-only flows.
Checkpointing saves step, message history and metadata to persistent storage after each step; on crash, reload and resume from there.
Resumability needs stateless workers on shared storage, idempotent steps safe to re-run, and granular saves rather than one at the end.
